name: Delicious Golden-Tempered Jade
desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. The skin has a satisfying firmness, and the meat is tender and flavorful. The natural gelatin from the chicken, set into a jelly, brims with the rich aroma of rendered chicken fat, and even the bones carry a subtle hint of sweetness. This dish is a true symphony of flavors, certain to delight even the most discerning gourmand.

value.text: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.
